material.description: OpenStax Introduction to Computer Science, §3.2 “Algorithm Design and Discovery” (https://openstax.org/books/introduction-computer-science/pages/3-2-algorithm-design-and-discovery): the “Algorithmic Problem Solving” passage defines an algorithm as a sequence of precise instructions that takes input and computes corresponding output. This supports the Claim’s step-sequence formulation without implying that every implementation is represented as a literal linear list.
